description: React component for the Request Detail Page in a mechanic request management system, including location extraction, geocoding, request status updates, and rendering request details with map view.

methods.name: toFiniteNumber
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number or null if invalid.

methods.name: extractLatLng
methods.description: Extracts latitude and longitude from request object, supporting multiple formats.

methods.name: extractAddressText
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable address or location string from request object.

methods.name: geocodeAddress
methods.description: Performs client-side geocoding using OpenStreetMap Nominatim API.

methods.name: RequestDetailPage
methods.description: Main React component for displaying and managing request details, status, and location.
